claim_policy.reservation_style: Courtesy reservation with contributor comment and maintainer acknowledgment
claim_policy.reservation_comment_template: I intend to work on VJ-NNN, packet COMMIT:PATH (DIGEST), for six hours after maintainer acknowledgment. My scope is the sealed packet; I will submit progress or release the reservation before expiry.
claim_policy.start_and_expiry: Maintainer records acknowledged start and six-hour expiry in UTC on the issue/Projects field.
claim_policy.expiry: Manual courtesy expiry and reassignment; no scheduled bot.
claim_policy.renewal: Explicit maintainer review of progress and remaining scope.

packet_policy.six_hours_is: claim lease, not promised completion time
readiness_requires: Task-class-specific frozen source/scope and acceptance policy; no missing required identity
Accepted prerequisite artifacts reviewed at exact revisions

Native GitHub status and acknowledged manual reservation reconciled by maintainers

activation_by_class.proof-only: Actual frozen Lean target/dependency/envelope plus qualified non-null validator.argv required
activation_by_class.implementation-with-proofs: Actual explicit implementation holes, independent total contract and qualified non-null validator.argv required
activation_by_class.maintainer-contract-release-infrastructu: Frozen manual review policy and applicable checks; nonapplicable mathematical fields have explicit reasons; no self-certification
activation_by_class.tests-docs: Frozen scope/expected evidence and applicable empirical/manual checks; no proof claim from tests

gate_definitions.name: Frozen inputs/readiness
gate_definitions.requirement: Task-class-specific frozen source, scope and applicable acceptance identities exist; mathematical classes require exact declaration/compiler/dependency/validator bindings, while manual-review tasks document nonapplicable fields with reasons.

gate_definitions.name: Fresh build/artifact verdict
gate_definitions.requirement: Pinned commands complete with correct exit codes and newly produced expected artifacts; missing checks and infrastructure errors cannot pass.

gate_definitions.name: Meaning and binding preservation
gate_definitions.requirement: Compare elaborated target types, hypotheses, semantics-bearing definitions/instances, input/output bindings and public-root mappings against frozen accepted records; textual names alone are insufficient.

gate_definitions.name: Axiom/native boundary audit
gate_definitions.requirement: Named roots and transitive proof dependencies satisfy the reviewed axiom basis; no placeholder/custom axiom or unproved native substitute gains a proved claim.

gate_definitions.name: Replay
gate_definitions.requirement: Fresh kernel replay and supported independent checker evidence cover the sealed closure; unsupported/incompatible checker is an explicit infrastructure gap.

gate_definitions.name: Existing-declaration reuse
gate_definitions.requirement: Before sealing proof work search the declaration index by name, statement and module; bind qualified existing results rather than reproving them.

gate_definitions.name: Nonvacuity and adversarial fixtures
gate_definitions.requirement: Constructive witnesses, syntax/profile/limit negatives and scoped mutants validate root premises and error-category distinctions.

gate_definitions.name: Allowed diff
gate_definitions.requirement: Only packet-allowed files/selectors changed; proof-only edits preserve all existing declarations/implementation/meaning, implementation-with-proofs edits preserve independently reviewed spec and root types.

gate_definitions.name: Scoped empirical checks
gate_definitions.requirement: Relevant tests/corpus/protocol/package evidence matches exact builds and profiles; it is not labeled an all-input proof.

gate_definitions.name: Independent acceptance
gate_definitions.requirement: Builder does not approve its own semantic, checker, CI, release or native-boundary changes; unresolved blockers prevent acceptance.
